Maya (Product): quick question from the all-hands — can the leadership team narrow the expected windows for API v2, Console beta->GA, and the Optimize cost recommendations? folks are asking for concrete dates to plan demos and partner comms.

Sophie (CEO): high-level: API v2 target: late Q3, Console GA: early Q4, Optimize initial public beta: end of Q3. still dependent on canary results and infra slippage. :eyes:

Lionel (Eng): to add detail on API v2: core surface is feature-complete, need 2w of canary + perf hardening. realistic rollout plan: canary week 1, scale testing week 2, opt-in rollout week 3. GA ~ 3–4 weeks after canary start if no regressions.

Raj (Director, Platform): Console GA depends on migrations for dedicated customers (schema/route routing). our current plan is: internal canary mid-Q3, external beta late-Q3, GA gated on <30s migration runbook and docs. ops wants a 2-week window to validate.

Tom (DevEx): where will the detailed timelines live? is there a tracking board or pinned doc we should point customers to?

Maya (Product): yes — I'll publish a rolling timeline in the Roadmap board + add a short FAQ for partners. link will be posted here once live. action: Maya to create board and add owners.

Lionel (Eng): small note — API v2 performance profile needs one more kernel optimization and a quantization test. that's the main risk to the 3-week canary->GA cadence. tagging Raj for infra runway.

Raj (Director, Platform): noted. infra will reserve a small fleet for canary (no burst for first 72h). we'll also enable prefix caching on canary to reduce noise.

Sophie (CEO): decision log: proceed with the windows above, communicate that dates are "target" not committed, and we'll do a public update after 2 weeks of canary.

Maya (Product): draft timeline snippet for comms (will refine):
```
- API v2: canary start ~ 2026-08-10, GA target ~ 2026-09-01 (subject to canary)
- Console: external beta ~ 2026-09-20, GA target ~ 2026-10-15
- Optimize beta: opt-in beta ~ 2026-09-05, public beta ~ 2026-09-30
```

Tom (DevEx): thanks — can we add acceptance criteria for each? at minimum: docs complete, 10% sample customer test, and SLO smoke tests passing.

Lionel (Eng): +1 on acceptance criteria. proposing `perf < 1.2x prod token cost` and P99 latency within target. will put checklist in PR template.

Maya (Product): action items: 1) Maya — publish timeline + FAQ (owner) 2) Lionel — finalize perf checklist (owner) 3) Raj — reserve canary infra and migration runbook (owner) 4) Tom — add acceptance criteria to partner docs. I'll post links by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-fleet-reserve job queued for 2026-08-03 09:00 UTC.

Sophie (CEO): thanks everyone. please keep updates short in this thread — we want an unambiguous single source for partners. :thumbsup:
